items.title: Chico Hamilton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] White psychologist, and you’re going to tell them; I have problems being around so many black people. Was it helpful? [INTERVIEWEE] Well I stayed in the hospital for about two or three weeks.
